mechanism_of_action: Cilofexor is a farnesoid X receptor agonist; firsocostat is an acetyl-CoA carboxylase inhibitor. Mechanisms for icosapent ethyl and fenofibrate are not stated.
efficacy_outcome: At 6 weeks of combination treatment, median triglyceride change was +41 mg/dL with icosapent ethyl and −2 mg/dL with fenofibrate; in the fenofibrate group, the within-group change was not significant (P = .92), while the icosapent ethyl group increased (P < .001).
safety_signal: Treatments were well tolerated; most treatment-emergent adverse events were Grade 1–2, with no discontinuations due to adverse events.
